g1.label: 1. The results ___
g1.why: Cautious academic writing says results “suggest”; “prove” and “guarantee” overclaim.

g2.label: 2. Climate change ___ a factor
g2.why: “Could be” hedges the claim; “is” and “must be” state it as certain.

g3.label: 3. ___ the trend will continue
g3.why: This opens the sentence tentatively, where the others assert certainty.

g4.label: 4. The survey found that ___ participants
g4.why: “The majority of” is accurate and cautious; “all” and “every” overstate the finding.

g5.label: 5. Early studies ___
g5.why: Early studies can indicate a direction, but cannot yet confirm or verify it.

g6.label: 6. These differences ___
g6.why: “Tend to be” allows exceptions; the alternatives claim certainty.

g7.label: 7. effective in ___ cases
g7.why: An approximate figure is more honest than claiming 100%.

g8.label: 8. The data ___ the hypothesis
g8.why: “Appear to support” hedges appropriately; the others are absolute claims.
